dialogues.source: You have got to be kidding me. I made my dad angry, just for this?!
dialogues.target: You have got to be kidding me. I made my dad angry, just for this?!

dialogues.source: He's going to murder me when I get home!
dialogues.target: He's going to murder me when I get home!

dialogues.source: Not just any food, my dear Gideon. This is top quality breakfast, one of a kind in Reverse Falls!
dialogues.target: Not just any food, my dear Gideon. This is top quality breakfast, one of a kind in Reverse Falls!

dialogues.source: Considering the size of this town it mustn't be very hard to find.
dialogues.target: Considering the size of this town it mustn't be very hard to find.

dialogues.source: Don’t be grumpy… Take a look at the menu!
dialogues.target: Don’t be grumpy… Take a look at the menu!

dialogues.info: Char: gideon(confused) | Voice: default_gideon_004 | [0]: CF gideon set confused
dialogues.source: If you think a menu is going to-[0] Hey, they have cake flavored pizza!
dialogues.target: If you think a menu is going to-[0] Hey, they have cake flavored pizza!

dialogues.source: Hehe, told you so! Order anything you’d like, it’s on me.
dialogues.target: Hehe, told you so! Order anything you’d like, it’s on me.

dialogues.source: Really…?
dialogues.target: Really…?

dialogues.source: The two enter at the diner and take a seat by the counter.
dialogues.target: The two enter at the diner and take a seat by the counter.

dialogues.source: “Babbling too fast to understand”
dialogues.target: “Babbling too fast to understand”

dialogues.source: What?
dialogues.target: What?

dialogues.source: Gideon, let me present to you the waitress of the Under the Rock,  “Active” Livia. Active Livia, here is my new friend, Gideon Pines.
dialogues.target: Gideon, let me present to you the waitress of the Under the Rock,  “Active” Livia. Active Livia, here is my new friend, Gideon Pines.

dialogues.source: Nice to meet… you?
dialogues.target: Nice to meet… you?

dialogues.source: “More babbling too fast to understand”
dialogues.target: “More babbling too fast to understand”

dialogues.source: <size=80%>Why is she talking so fast?
dialogues.target: <size=80%>Why is she talking so fast?

dialogues.source: She REALLY likes espresso, so much so that she even invented a way of duplicating her amount of caffeíne per cup.
dialogues.target: She REALLY likes espresso, so much so that she even invented a way of duplicating her amount of caffeíne per cup.

dialogues.source: How??
dialogues.target: How??

dialogues.source: “Even more babbling too fast to understand”
dialogues.target: “Even more babbling too fast to understand”

dialogues.source: And isn’t there a way of making her calm down so I can understand what she’s saying?
dialogues.target: And isn’t there a way of making her calm down so I can understand what she’s saying?

dialogues.source: Yep, we just have to say the magic words.
dialogues.target: Yep, we just have to say the magic words.

dialogues.source: Hey, Livia!
dialogues.target: Hey, Livia!

dialogues.source: Yeah?
dialogues.target: Yeah?

dialogues.source: Can I have a “Sleeping Beauty”?
dialogues.target: Can I have a “Sleeping Beauty”?

dialogues.source: “Babbling too fast” Sure!
dialogues.target: “Babbling too fast” Sure!

dialogues.source: What’s a “Sleeping Beauty?”
dialogues.target: What’s a “Sleeping Beauty?”

dialogues.source: It’s a triple ​​chamomile tea with a touch of sleeping pills.
dialogues.target: It’s a triple ​​chamomile tea with a touch of sleeping pills.

dialogues.source: Whoa.
dialogues.target: Whoa.

dialogues.source: Yeah, I plan to mix it with her “Death Wish” coffee.
dialogues.target: Yeah, I plan to mix it with her “Death Wish” coffee.

dialogues.source: Death wish coffee?
dialogues.target: Death wish coffee?

dialogues.source: Oh! Shh! Here she comes!
dialogues.target: Oh! Shh! Here she comes!

dialogues.source: Livia comes in with a large cup of tea that she places on the table. In her other hand rests her own coffee, which she takes a sip of as she places Pacifica’s order down.
dialogues.target: Livia comes in with a large cup of tea that she places on the table. In her other hand rests her own coffee, which she takes a sip of as she places Pacifica’s order down.

dialogues.source: “Babbling too fast to understand”
dialogues.target: “Babbling too fast to understand”

dialogues.source: Oh, hey! Look at that! What’s that behind you?
dialogues.target: Oh, hey! Look at that! What’s that behind you?

dialogues.source: Huh? What?
dialogues.target: Huh? What?

dialogues.source: Where?
dialogues.target: Where?

dialogues.source: Yeah, it’s right there, can’t you see it?
dialogues.target: Yeah, it’s right there, can’t you see it?

dialogues.source: Pacifica quickly pours the tea into Livia’s mug hurriedly, right before she turns back around.
dialogues.target: Pacifica quickly pours the tea into Livia’s mug hurriedly, right before she turns back around.

dialogues.source: Ohhh, It’s gone! I’m so sorry that you couldn't see it!
dialogues.target: Ohhh, It’s gone! I’m so sorry that you couldn't see it!

dialogues.source: ”babbles a bit more”
dialogues.target: ”babbles a bit more”

dialogues.source: Livia proceeds to take another sip of her coffee.
dialogues.target: Livia proceeds to take another sip of her coffee.

dialogues.source: How long does it take to have an effect?
dialogues.target: How long does it take to have an effect?

dialogues.info: Char: pacifica(idle) | Voice: default_pacifica_016 | [0]: C Livia set blank

dialogues.source: Whoa… Is it just me or is the world moving so much faster now?
dialogues.target: Whoa… Is it just me or is the world moving so much faster now?

dialogues.source: Nah, it’s just you. So what were you saying before the thing showed up?
dialogues.target: Nah, it’s just you. So what were you saying before the thing showed up?

dialogues.source: The what?
dialogues.target: The what?

dialogues.source: The thing, the thing that made you turn around?
dialogues.target: The thing, the thing that made you turn around?

dialogues.source: Oh right, I was saying that I really shouldn’t legally sell you the “Sleeping Beauty”, due to its components.
dialogues.target: Oh right, I was saying that I really shouldn’t legally sell you the “Sleeping Beauty”, due to its components.

dialogues.source: So why did you sell it anyway?
dialogues.target: So why did you sell it anyway?

dialogues.source: Oh, because I knew that Pacifica wouldn’t tell anyone, I trust her, and I would do the same for her if she needed me to keep a secret.
dialogues.target: Oh, because I knew that Pacifica wouldn’t tell anyone, I trust her, and I would do the same for her if she needed me to keep a secret.

dialogues.source: Awww!
dialogues.target: Awww!

dialogues.source: <size=80%>Oh, god, that’s so illegal.
dialogues.target: <size=80%>Oh, god, that’s so illegal.

dialogues.source: Alright, do you two want to order anything else?
dialogues.target: Alright, do you two want to order anything else?

dialogues.source: Uhhh… The cake flavored pizza please. Extra um… sprinkles?
dialogues.target: Uhhh… The cake flavored pizza please. Extra um… sprinkles?

dialogues.source: And the usual pancakes for me!
dialogues.target: And the usual pancakes for me!

dialogues.source: Lots of whipped cream please!
dialogues.target: Lots of whipped cream please!

dialogues.source: Coming right up.
dialogues.target: Coming right up.

dialogues.source: You two seem to know each other very well.
dialogues.target: You two seem to know each other very well.

dialogues.source: Of course we do! She’s the nearest thing I have to a bestie.
dialogues.target: Of course we do! She’s the nearest thing I have to a bestie.

dialogues.source: I see . . .
dialogues.target: I see . . .

dialogues.source: Are you sure about paying for our meal?
dialogues.target: Are you sure about paying for our meal?

dialogues.source: Yeah, it’d be my pleasure! To commemorate our newfound friendship and all.
dialogues.target: Yeah, it’d be my pleasure! To commemorate our newfound friendship and all.

dialogues.source: Wow that’s… that’s actually really kind of you. Thanks…
dialogues.target: Wow that’s… that’s actually really kind of you. Thanks…

dialogues.source: Don’t sweat it, I love making my friends happy! I haven’t been making many around here, so it’s honestly nice.
dialogues.target: Don’t sweat it, I love making my friends happy! I haven’t been making many around here, so it’s honestly nice.

dialogues.source: Plus, I still need your help hunting down that thing from yesterday!
dialogues.target: Plus, I still need your help hunting down that thing from yesterday!

dialogues.source: Right, so… What should we do about that little blue dorito? Didn’t you want to capture him?
dialogues.target: Right, so… What should we do about that little blue dorito? Didn’t you want to capture him?

dialogues.source: Yup, but I’m not really sure how to start just yet.. We should figure out a plan after we’ve eaten.
dialogues.target: Yup, but I’m not really sure how to start just yet.. We should figure out a plan after we’ve eaten.

dialogues.info: Char: pacifica(joyful) | Voice: default_pacifica_027 | [0]: Sound hit_on_table | [1]: Screen shake
dialogues.source: After all, [0][1]the best ideas come once you've eaten lots of sugar… Or something like that.
dialogues.target: After all, [0][1]the best ideas come once you've eaten lots of sugar… Or something like that.

dialogues.source: There is a sudden commotion in the diner.
dialogues.target: There is a sudden commotion in the diner.

dialogues.source: No!!!
dialogues.target: No!!!

dialogues.source: That ascot was a gift! You can’t just replace it like that!
dialogues.target: That ascot was a gift! You can’t just replace it like that!

dialogues.source: I can’t deal with you anymore…
dialogues.target: I can’t deal with you anymore…

dialogues.source: We’re through!
dialogues.target: We’re through!

dialogues.source: But… But mi Linda!
dialogues.target: But… But mi Linda!

dialogues.source: It wasn’t my fault! Some weird monster destroyed it!
dialogues.target: It wasn’t my fault! Some weird monster destroyed it!

dialogues.source: Who would actually believe that?!
dialogues.target: Who would actually believe that?!

dialogues.source: You're such an ass, Scot!
dialogues.target: You're such an ass, Scot!

dialogues.source: Rosanna! NOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!!!
dialogues.target: Rosanna! NOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!!!

dialogues.source: We’re through!
dialogues.target: We’re through!

dialogues.source: The woman stands up and quickly leaves the dinner, a stifling silence left in her wake.
dialogues.target: The woman stands up and quickly leaves the dinner, a stifling silence left in her wake.
